data.summary: All figures match Tesla's reported FY2023/FY2022 results. Revenue was $96.77B vs $81.46B (+18.8%). Gross profit was $17.66B vs $20.85B, an 18.2% margin. Operating income was $8.89B vs $13.66B, a 9.2% margin. R&D was $3.97B vs $3.08B. Net income was $15.0B vs $12.56B (+19.4%). Diluted EPS was $4.30 vs $3.62. The rounding note is correct: the stated ratios come from unrounded figures. The point about below-the-line items is valid: FY2023 included a one-time tax benefit of about $5.9B from releasing a reserve against deferred tax assets.
